messages:
liam (AE): Heads-up: FinnoPay wants a short POC to validate automated receipts/entity extraction for KYC. They need a clear acceptance checklist, a short timeline (2 weeks), and an up-front estimate. Can we scope this today?

marta (SE): OK — couple clarifying q's: 1) main artifact = structured entity extraction (name, dob, id_number, transaction_amt) from OCRed images? 2) will buyer supply a labeled golden set?

liam (AE): yes to both — they'll hand over ~150 labeled examples + 30 edge cases. Primary constraints: PII masking mandatory, and they want p95 latency under 300ms. Peak throughput ~350 reqs/min.

tom (Solutions Eng): For a tight POC we should run 3 axis: correctness, latency, and privacy. Proposed minimal acceptance: holdout eval on the 150 cases, p95 <= 300ms, entity F1 >= 0.88 (normalized), and no unmasked PII in logs. Also propose a safety canary stage.

marta (SE): prompts/evals plan: ask for the 150 golden examples, plus 20 adversarial cases where formatting is garbage. We'll test: model A (fp16), model A-int8, and model A-int8 + prefix cache. We'll capture token counts and per-request duration.

liam (AE): timeline question: buyer wants kickoff next Tue. We need infra + security signed off before. How long to provision a VPC test instance?

marta (SE): VPC peering + KMS setup takes ~48-72 hours. If legal approves the security questionnaire by EOD Fri we can provision Mon and kickoff Tue. Need an NDA appendix for logs retention too.

alex (AM): commercial Q: they prefer predictable pricing for the POC. Can we offer a capped flat fee with clear overage? Also what's our standard POC credit for Dedicated testing?

marta (SE): recommend a two-week reserved bundle: $5k flat (covers reserved capacity + support) + overage billed at hosted-list per-token if exceeded. If they convert to a Dedicated contract within 30 days, apply the $5k as credit to first invoice.

benchmarks-bot: AUTO-BENCH: estimated perf for redwood-infer-a1-int8 on g5-type infra: p50 ~45ms, p95 ~210ms, throughput ~240 tps, expected cache savings ~20% for short-prefix workloads.

security-bot: SECURITY CHECK: missing items flagged - BYOK (KMS) integration to be validated, audit-log retention policy needed, SOC2 evidence requested. Confirm whether POC will be Private (VPC) or Hosted.

liam (AE): buyer requires Private VPC + BYOK. I'll ask them to send KMS ARNs and SOC2 excerpt. Legal will need time to review.

legal (Counsel): I'll review SOC2 excerpt and security annex. Expect 24-48h turnaround once buyer sends docs. We'll need an NDA appendix for log access.

tom (Solutions Eng): Operational runbook sketch (to include in SOW):
```
- Provision VPC test instance (48h)
- Configure BYOK & audit logging (24h)
- Deploy models (fp16 / int8) and warm cache
- Canary: route 10% of synthetic traffic for 2k requests -> check perf/accuracy
- Ramp to full load and run 7-day validated window
- Snapshot logs + eval results -> review with buyer
```

marta (SE): suggest SOW acceptance bullets (to include verbatim):
```
- Latency: p95 <= 300ms on buyer test traffic
- Correctness: entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on the held-out golden set
- Privacy: BYOK enabled; no unmasked PII in persisted logs
- Reliability: >= 98% successful responses during POC window
- Cost: POC flat fee $5k; overage billed at hosted-list rates
```

alex (AM): I'll draft SOW + risk appendix (fallback policies: auto-fallback to smaller model or read-only response mode). Need final thresholds before sending to buyer.

liam (AE): I'll collect the golden set and SOC2 excerpt from buyer today and push to legal. Also will ask them to prioritize sending KMS ARNs. Plan: if legal clears by Mon morning, provisioning starts Mon and we hit Tue kickoff.

marta (SE): I'll open infra ticket for VPC provisioning and KMS config; owner assigned @marta. Also uploading initial eval script and prompt templates to the shared drive.

tom (Solutions Eng): owner list: @marta for infra/provision, @tom for runbook & scoring, @alex for commercial. If anything blocks, drop into this thread.

liam (AE): thanks — updating SOW with the acceptance bullets now. Will post a follow-up thread when legal signs off. :thumbsup:
